description:
GATED (2026-08-15): targets the Distributor recruitment paths that exist only on the unmerged feature/q67-phase-a branch, which must first be reconciled with the qzr rework (see bedrock-q67 epic). Note the qzr work already landed epoch-guarded TSL-driven worker reconciliation on develop (7b57281f) — the reconciliation approach described below may be partly or wholly subsumed; re-check before implementing.

bedrock-q67.7 added best-effort Foreman.remove_worker cleanup on the recruitment failure paths where the worker id is known (lock failed, unlock failed, TSL delta rejected - see Recruitment.remove_orphaned_worker/3). Residual leaks that cheap wins cannot cover: (1) the recruitment task crashes (rescue/catch in Distributor.Server.spawn_recruitment_task) between worker creation and completion - the worker id is lost with the task; (2) the distributor or its node dies mid-recruitment; (3) remove_worker itself fails (foreman unreachable) and is deliberately swallowed. Fix should be reconciliation, not a GC bolted to recruitment: e.g. on distributor start (or periodically) list Foreman.materializer_workers per node and remove materializer workers whose pid is not named in the current TSL shard_materializers and not the metadata materializer. Must be epoch-guarded so a stale distributor cannot reap a newer epoch's recruits.
title: Recruitment orphan residuals: reconcile workers leaked by task crashes or distributor death
